strings.en:
{1c:11}I was the one who said I wanted to use
what I got from training, and my skill
with the spear, to help people, and
{10} agreed with me,{1a}and to earn money to donate to Sara's
orphanage, the two of us started
working as mercenaries. That was
exactly two years ago...{1a}The vows we made when we set out:
'Never side with the stronger.' 'Never
side with bad people.'{1a}'After living costs, every bit of what we
earn goes to Sara's orphanage.' Thanks
to keeping those three vows,{1a}we could never afford any luxury, but
every single day was so much fun.{0c:020301}

いつの間にかその筋では
すっかり有{e0a2}人になっちゃって、{1a}{e0a3}場で{e0a4}{e0a5}に{e0a6}い物してただけなのに、{1a}あたしの顔見た屈強そうな男の人が

{0c:51002b501000}{1c:11}So much has happened, hasn't it.{1a}While we fought our way from place to

totally famous in certain circles,{1a}and even when I was just shopping at
the market like normal,{1a}some big burly man would see my face,

everyone around would stare at me...{1a}{0c:5108}The biggest shock of all was {10}
seeing that and laughing out
loud, though.{0c:fe}

素直に受け入れられる。{1a}ただし、あたし達の『永遠』は、
あの人達の求めた『永遠』とは
全く違うものだけど。{0c:fe}

ずっと変わらないと思う・・・{1a}あなたと出逢えて本当によかった。
あなたを好きになって本当によかった。{1a}きっと、ずっとそう思える。{1a}{0c:5120}ありがと、{10}、
あたしの前に{e0ab}れてくれて。{0c:fe}
